About

CANARY CRY NEWS TALK is a show that brings frequent updates on news and events happening around the world from an Alt. Christian worldview, hosted by us, Basil and Gonz of the Canary Cry Radio podcast.

GONZ is a filmmaker and producer. He runs an online media ministry on the FaceLikeTheSun YouTube channel.

BASIL is an enigma. He runs The Joyspiracy Theory podcast.
